!HBLTS5-5  # only HBLTS5 has a -4 version (M4 screw); the plain code is the M5 one
!HBLTV5-4  # -4 (M4 screw) is offered for HBLTS5 only
!HBKUS5-4  # -4 (M4 screw) is offered for HBLTS5 only
!HBLTSWB5  # HBLTSW5 has no black anodized version in the catalogue
!HBLTX5  # unknown bracket type
!HBLTS6  # 6 series (slot 8 mm) brackets are not drawn
!HBLTSB5-C  # alteration C (M5 taps) is not offered for HBLTSB5 on the catalogue page
!HBKTSB5-C  # alteration C is not offered for the black HBKTSB5 (nor HBKTST5, HBKUSB5)
!HBLTS5-SET-C  # one alteration at most
!HBLTS5-XYZ  # not an alteration the catalogue lists (C, SET, SST, SEU, SSU, SEP, SSP, SEC)
!HBLFSN5  # a valid tabbed reversal bracket of the same catalogue, not drawn here
